meta.source: astronomy-engine 2.1.19 (VSOP87 planetary theory, ELP/MPP02-derived lunar model), MIT licence. NOT JPL Horizons.
meta.generatedFrom: analytic planetary/lunar theory; sub-arcminute accuracy; not a substitute for DE-series ephemerides
meta.frame: J2000 mean ecliptic and equinox (right-handed, +Z ecliptic north)
meta.timeScale: UTC calendar dates (UT/TT difference of ~1 min is ignored)
meta.interpolation: cubic Hermite using position and velocity
meta.note: Heliocentric (Sun-centred) for Earth and Mars; geocentric (Earth-centred) for the Moon. Never mix origins without an explicit transform.
